title: Britain's Poppies: The First World War Remembered
original_title: Britain's Poppies: The First World War Remembered
overview: In 2014 a unique art installation was unveiled at the Tower of London. Called 'The Blood Swept Lands and Seas of Red' , this tribute to the British and colonial lives lost, was the start of a remarkable four-year journey across the UK
